newsitem.title: USA: Sun Healthcare says agency ends probe.
newsitem.headline: Sun Healthcare says agency ends probe.

text.p: Sun Healthcare Group Inc said Wednesday that the criminal division of the U.S. Justice Department has informed Sun that it has completed its investigation of the company, and that it will not initiate any actions against Sun or any individuals.

The company said the Justice Department has concluded its investigation into billing practices of Sun's subsidiaries. This aspect of the investigation has been completed without the company being required to pay any money or without being penalized in any manner.

As Sun has previously disclosed, the company has been the subject of an investigation for more than two years by the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services' Office of Inspector General and the Department of Justice.
The investigation by the civil division of the Department of Justice and the OIG is still proceeding, the company said.

Sun said it continues to cooperate with the investigators on this matter. The company said it is unable to determine at this time when the remaining aspects of the investigation will be concluded or the precise scope of the civil investigation. The company said it is hopeful the investigation will be concluded by the end of the year and it does not believe the outcome will have a material adverse effect on its financial condition or results of operations.
